speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Singapore will always be a work in progress.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) seeks to plan and build a better Singapore for current and future generations of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Home ownership remains the key social pillar of our nation.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: It gives Singaporeans a tangible stake in our country and a critical sense of belonging.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also ensure that public housing remains affordable for all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have enhanced housing grants significantly for both new and resale flats in recent years and will continue to review our policies to keep Housing and Development Board (HDB) flats affordable.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The new HDB flats will be spread across mature and non-mature estates.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The waiting times for these flats are typically around four years.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Tengah will be designed as a “Forest Town”, surrounded by lush greenery and nature.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Residents will have convenient access to a wide range of amenities and will enjoy quality living with homes equipped with smart and eco-friendly features.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Residents will also benefit from more seamless connectivity within the town, be it by public transport or dedicated cycling paths, as well as new forms of mobility, such as autonomous or driverless vehicles.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Even as we do more to improve the design of new towns, we will continue to renew and rejuvenate our existing housing estates and flats through various initiatives, such as the Remaking our Heartland programme, Neighbourhood Renewal Programme and Home Improvement Programme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: At the same time, we will pay special attention to the housing needs of particular groups of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: First, for our seniors, we will pilot a new model of assisted living that combines housing with care services, to enable them to live independently and with dignity.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will review and update the Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme with new items, such as accessibility solutions for flats with multi-step entrances.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also do more to help seniors who wish to monetise the value of their flats for retirement.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Second, we will continue with efforts to help vulnerable Singaporeans, especially those living in rental flats.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Fresh Start Housing Scheme has given second-timer public rental families a better chance to own a home again.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will study how to further support the home ownership aspirations of our tenants in public rental.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Beyond our housing policies, we will plan and build a smarter, greener and more liveable city.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: First, we will continue with our master-planning efforts to shape a distinctive Singapore, one with the comforts of a modern city and with its own character, charm and identity.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Our Civic District is a good example of what is possible, with its well-utilised public spaces and beautifully-restored heritage buildings adapted for arts and cultural uses.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Second, we will partner stakeholders to create public and green spaces for all to enjoy.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Fort Canning Park will be rejuvenated with enhanced heritage trails, new galleries and more family-friendly spaces.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: There will also be opportunities for communities along the 24-kilometre (km) Rail Corridor to shape its programming and development.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: By 2021, the Rail Corridor will be linked to parks, nature areas and trails, such as the Coast-to-Coast Trail and the 150-km Round Island Route, giving Singaporeans multiple options to explore green spaces all over our island.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Third, we will support the local farming sector to boost productivity and enhance our food security.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We released new farm land for the first time in over two decades, and the enhanced Agricultural Productivity Fund will help local farms adopt more productive technologies.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We will also do more to strengthen the overall food ecosystem to keep our food supply safe and resilient.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Facility management and property transaction services will also be part of this industry transformation, with a strong push on Design for Maintainability and smart facility management to keep our built infrastructure in good shape.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The work we do over the next few years is critical because it will set the foundation for longer-term major projects that are in the pipeline.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Over the coming decade, Singapore will be undergoing its most extensive transformation yet.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We have new and tremendous possibilities to make Singapore stand out as a leading city for Asia and the world.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We are building Changi Airport Terminal 5 and Tuas Port to expand our airport and seaport capacities, and to position ourselves for the future.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We are also building two new connections to Malaysia – the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail and Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: All these will strengthen our air, sea and land links with the world and enhance our status as a regional and international hub.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: These will enable us to broaden our urban development, attract more investments and support the creation of jobs closer to home.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We want to make full use of technologies to uplift our quality of life and to take Singapore’s sustainable development to the next level.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: At the same time, we are redoubling our efforts to green Singapore and enhance our City in a Garden.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: In this next phase of urban transformation, we must work even harder to distinguish ourselves from other global cities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We want Singapore to be a truly outstanding city for Asia and the world, where the human spirit flourishes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We want to be an inclusive city for Singaporeans of all ages and abilities; a home where everyone has a place and everyone belongs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: To achieve this, we must move beyond the status quo.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: That is why we have set out bold plans to transform our city.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: We want to partner all Singaporeans – the community, businesses and other stakeholders – to shape our future city together.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Singapore is our home, where we raise our families, create shared memories and forge close bonds with one another.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Together, we can build a better home and a better Singapore for our families and for future generations of Singaporeans.
